decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-4024cb69f8ce] names the exact metric and its new name: envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_connected_state becomes envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_connected_state. The section context [ev-77f05428497a] says this is part of a general rename of the prefix for all Envoy NPDS metrics, from envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_ to envoy_cilium_npds_, and lists it under 1.17 Changed Metrics. Neither excerpt gives a config condition for the rename, so for the open applicability aspect it reads as unconditional in 1.17.0: it covers any environment that emits these Envoy NPDS metrics. Monitoring that queries the old name will stop finding it. This is enough to write the typed assertion; whether anyone actually queries the old name is a matter for the customer's environment, not a gap in the release evidence.
